data.disagreement_analysis: The 'inconclusive' vs 'safe' disagreement was caused by tool-level failures (HTTP 400 error and response parsing failure) when two models attempted to audit the Changelog file. The deepseek model processed it successfully and correctly identified it as a benign plain-text file.
coverage_issues: qwen and openrouter models failed to audit the Changelog file due to API/parse errors, resulting in an inconclusive overall verdict.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API calls and response parsing to prevent transient errors on simple text files from causing an overall inconclusive verdict.
The advisory flag correctly isolated the openrouter/free model's parse error from the consensus, demonstrating the value of tiered model trust.
